description: Use when the user wants a small, well-bounded change done now without a plan file — a bugfix, config change, rename, doc update or simple refactor touching 1–5 files — 'corrigir rapidinho', 'quick fix no X', 'renomear Y'. Presents a mini-plan, implements after approval, verifies and commits. Do NOT use for more than 5 files, architectural decisions, migrations or new UI flows (use feat-feature / feat-backend / feat-frontend).
